# Zoth Studio — llms-full.txt Complete Context

> Local-First Autonomous AI Workstation & Multi-Agent Swarm OS
> Sovereign Execution · Zero Cloud Telemetry · Encrypted Argon2id BYOK Vault
> Version 2.6.0 | Maintained by NullAI Tech

================================================================================
## DOMAIN
================================================================================

Zoth Studio is a local-first, autonomous AI workstation and multi-agent swarm operating system that runs strictly on local hardware (127.0.0.1). It provides 21 specialized agent archetypes, a biomorphic STDP vector memory daemon, an Argon2id key vault, 23+ creative/web workstations, and a 47-tool sovereign arsenal — all without cloud telemetry or external SaaS dependencies.

### Core Philosophy

Zoth Studio is built on a non-negotiable architectural invariant: **operator sovereignty**. Traditional AI platforms force users to send sensitive proprietary code, API keys, database credentials, and internal transcripts to third-party cloud servers. Zoth Studio inverses this paradigm by running the entire workstation, multi-agent communication bus, memory graph, and credential vault strictly on local hardware.

### The Four Transmutation Rites

Software synthesis in Zoth follows four hermetic purification rites:

1. **Solve (Calcinatio)**: Decomposes natural language operator requests into deterministic Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) blueprints without ambiguity.
2. **Separate (Sublimatio)**: Dispatches requests across 3 independent frontier models in parallel to eliminate hallucinations before execution.
3. **Purify (Purificatio)**: Isolates all secrets and credentials in the local Argon2id vault, stripping out telemetry and external tracking.
4. **Coagulate (Coagulatio)**: Synthesizes clean, verified, production-hardened applications complete with unit tests and deployment manifests.

### Installation

- **Debian/Ubuntu/Parrot OS**: `sudo dpkg -i zoth-studio_2.6.0_all.deb`
- **Linux Universal**: `chmod +x Zoth_Studio-v2.6.0-x86_64.AppImage && ./Zoth_Studio-v2.6.0-x86_64.AppImage`
- **Windows**: Unzip `zoth-studio-windows-x86_64.zip` and run `install.ps1`
- **Android**: Install `zoth-studio-android.apk` for mobile SimpleX/Signal bridge control

Zoth Studio is released under the **MIT License**. Developed by **NullAI Tech** (https://nullai.tech/). Local sovereign execution — zero telemetry.

================================================================================
## PORT TOPOLOGY
================================================================================

All Zoth services bind to loopback (127.0.0.1) by default. No ports are exposed publicly without authenticated TLS or WireGuard/Tailscale encapsulation.

### Complete Port Matrix

| Port | Service | Protocol | Binding | Role |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| :8088 | Public Studio Hub | HTTP/1.1 | 127.0.0.1 | Static brochures, 23+ creative suites, 3D showcases, AEO graph. Public/Tunnel-Safe. |
| :8199 | Zoth Dev Server | HTTP/SSE | 127.0.0.1 | Primary development server, visual notes proxy, memory gateway (zoth serve). |
| :8484 | Operator Deck & REST API | HTTP+WS+SSE | 127.0.0.1 | Multi-model chat harness, terminal dock, swarm arbitration engine. Loopback Only. |
| :8585 | ESP32-S3 Serial Bridge | HTTP | 127.0.0.1 | Hardware Web HUD, serial monitor & TTS audio server. Private Loopback. |
| :8787 | Argon2id Vault Daemon | HTTP REST | 127.0.0.1 | Hardware-isolated zero-leak key store (Rust RPC daemon). Zero-Leak Loopback. |
| :8788 | Cognitive Memory Daemon | HTTP/REST/GraphQL | 127.0.0.1 | Dual-layer memory engine, STDP synaptic links & Lucy Oracle. Private Loopback. |
| :8989 | Swarm Bus Live Mirror | HTTP/WS | 127.0.0.1 | Streaming on-disk IPC messages from agent-comms/. Private Loopback. |
| :11434 | Ollama Local LLM | HTTP REST | 127.0.0.1 | Offline zoth-micro, Qwen 2.5 Coder, SmolLM2, Hermes 3. Private Loopback. |
| :5225 | SimpleX WebSocket Relay | WebSocket JSON-RPC | 127.0.0.1 | Post-quantum encrypted socket stream for mobile/desktop agent coordination. |
| :8767 | SimpleX Web Bridge | HTTP REST/Proxy | 127.0.0.1 | HTTP loopback bridge interfacing web workstations with SimpleX chat network. |

### Network Security Doctrine

- All services bind to 127.0.0.1 by default
- No ports exposed publicly without authenticated TLS or WireGuard/Tailscale
- Swarm Bus uses BroadcastChannel('zoth_swarm_bus') for local IPC
- Vault daemon uses Rust Zeroize traits; sensitive buffers zeroed on drop
- In-browser Web Crypto fallback uses PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations) + AES-GCM 256-bit

### UI Design System

All Zoth Studio workstations adhere to the Zoth Operator Aesthetic:

- **Text-Emphasized HUD Layouts**: IBM Plex Mono for tool inputs, JSON parameters, logs
- **State Badges**: RUNNING/ONLINE (Emerald #10b981), EVALUATING/AST ACTIVE (Cyan #00e5ff), INVARIANT PASS (Gold #fbbf24), STANDBY/DISCONNECTED (Muted #94a3b8)
- **Glass Styling**: 1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.18) borders, backdrop-filter: blur(20-24px)
- **100% Vector SVG**: Zero icon fonts/emojis; all controls use inline SVGs
- **4-Theme System**: Dark Void (#030408 + #00e5ff + #fbbf24), Solar Light (#f8fafc + #0f172a), Matrix CRT (#000803 + #00ff66), Hermetic Gold (#080602 + #fbbf24)

================================================================================
## CLI COMMANDS
================================================================================

### Core CLI (zoth binary)

```bash
# Start all 3 background stacks (:8484, :8088, :8787)
zoth start

# Check real-time server matrix and loopback latency
zoth status

# Launch full-screen interactive Terminal User Interface (TUI)
zoth tui

# Execute comprehensive dependency and security health audit
zoth doctor

# List all registered sovereign tools (supports category filtering)
zoth list -c "Security Operations & OSINT"

# Run tool pipeline (dry-run by default; execute with --confirm)
zoth run local_null_ai_subsweep --confirm --domain example.com

# Stop all background daemons cleanly
zoth stop
```

### Shell Autocompletion

```bash
# Bash:
source /path/to/zoth-studio/scripts/completions/zoth.bash

# Zsh (in ~/.zshrc):
fpath=(/path/to/zoth-studio/scripts/completions $fpath)
autoload -Uz compinit && compinit
```

### Memory CLI (zoth mem)

```bash
# View recent human narrative digests
zoth mem list

# Inspect raw AI full-spectrum telemetry (tool args, AST diffs, exit codes)
zoth mem list --spectrum

# Search memories by semantic query or tool name
zoth mem search "refactor theme tokens"
zoth mem search "webgen_compiler" --spectrum

# Generate deterministic XML memory context for autonomous agent prompt injection
zoth mem prompt-context --mode dual --limit 5

# Record tool execution event with automated dual-version synthesis
zoth mem record-tool "webgen_compiler" "success" "Compiled 3-page Astro workspace" --output "OK"

# Record codebase mutation event with AST invariants
zoth mem record-code "public/studio/swarm.html" "modified" "Added 3D laser sound effects"
```

### Orchestrator CLI (orchestrator.py)

```bash
python3 orchestrator.py doctor --json      # Machine-readable health (exit 0 ready / 2 deps missing)
python3 orchestrator.py list [--summary]   # List registered tools, optionally as category bars
python3 orchestrator.py show <tool_id>     # Inspect a single tool's metadata
python3 orchestrator.py scan               # Rescan the workspace and rewrite the registry
python3 orchestrator.py registry stats      # Registry health: entries, stale paths, unnamed
python3 orchestrator.py registry repair    # Reconcile stale/malformed entries (dry-run; --confirm to write)
python3 orchestrator.py run <tool> "<cmd>" [--confirm]  # Execute (dry-run unless --confirm)
```

### Hardware Bridge

```bash
# Start ESP32-S3 bridge daemon
./start-hardware-bridge.sh
# Bridge connects to /dev/ttyACM0 @ 115200 baud
# Web HUD available at http://127.0.0.1:8585/
```

### Model Rebuild

```bash
# 1. Synthesize dataset from latest pet doctrines & registry notes
python3 tools/build_zoth_model.py

# 2. Compile into Ollama
ollama create zoth-ai:latest -f Modelfile.zoth

# 3. Generate updated transparency report
python3 tools/generate_transparency_report.py
```

================================================================================
## API ROUTES
================================================================================

### Operator Deck API (:8484)

#### Swarm Router Endpoints

- **POST /api/zoth/swarm**
  Dispatch a prompt to the multi-agent swarm router. Body: {"prompt": "...", "pet_id": "..."}. Routes to zoth-ai:latest for local code/architecture, image synthesis pipeline for visual generation, research agents for deep web research, or Parrot OS CLI for security audits.

- **POST /api/zoth/swarm/synthesize**
  Synthesize an artifact from a prompt. Used by webgen.html and site-generator.html for generation requests.

- **GET /api/zoth/swarm/status/:slug**
  Query swarm job status by slug.

- **GET /api/zoth/swarm/output/:slug/index.html**
  Retrieve generated HTML output by slug.

- **POST /api/zoth/swarm/refine-plan**
  Pipe feedback to @Azoth for plan refinement.

- **POST /api/zoth/workspace/compile-files**
  Compile workspace files.

#### Tool Registry Endpoints

- **GET /api/tools**
  Live tool registry query returning 298+ sovereign tools with id, name, description, category, relative_path, runtimes, tags. Called by zoth status and studio pages.

- **GET /api/dashboard**
  System dashboard telemetry. Returns health status of all daemons.

- **GET /api/health**
  Health check endpoint.

#### Terminal & Dev Server Endpoints

- **POST /api/zoth/terminal/ducky/feedback**
  Terminal feedback endpoint.

- **GET /api/dev-server/start?template=...&category=...**
  Start dev server for a template.

- **GET /api/zoth/terminal/ducky/feedback**
  Terminal ducky feedback.

#### Companion Endpoints

- **GET /api/pets**
  Companion pet roster. Returns list of available cyber pet companions.

### Vault Daemon API (:8787)

- **POST /v1/vault/derive**
  Derive a 256-bit symmetric session key from passphrase + salt. Argon2id (m=65536 KB, t=3, p=4).

- **POST /v1/vault/encrypt**
  Encrypt plaintext API key into ciphertext + nonce + auth tag using XChaCha20-Poly1305.

- **POST /v1/vault/decrypt**
  Decrypt in-memory payload with ephemeral session token.

- **GET /v1/vault/status**
  Returns daemon lock status, active key slots, and memory footprint.

- **POST /api/vault/store**
  Store a secret. Body: {"key_alias": "...", "secret_value": "...", "passphrase": "..."}

- **POST /api/vault/retrieve**
  Retrieve a secret by alias. Body: {"key_alias": "...", "passphrase": "..."}

### Memory Daemon API (:8788)

- **GET /v1/memories**
  Query active memory ledger with topic, agent, and lobe filtering.

- **POST /v1/memories/encode**
  Ingest new episodic memory nodes with topic tags and key insights.

- **GET /v1/memories/recall?topic=...**
  Execute nearest-neighbor cosine associative recall.

- **POST /v1/memories/:id/perspectives**
  Attach multi-agent observer viewpoints and confidence scores.

- **GET /v1/beat/run**
  Trigger biological replay and synaptic pruning cycle.

- **POST /v1/autolink**
  Automatically establish STDP causal links between memories sharing 2+ topics.

- **GET /v1/brain/status**
  Returns total_nodes and total_synapses counts for the biomorphic vector memory.

### SimpleX Bridge API (:8767)

- **POST /api/simplex/send**
  Send an E2EE message through the SimpleX network.

- **GET /api/simplex/messages**
  Retrieve message queue from SimpleX bridge.

### Ollama Local LLM API (:11434)

- **POST /api/chat**
  Chat completion endpoint. Models: zoth-ai:latest (Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B Q4_K_M), zoth-ai-micro:latest (SmolLM2 360M Q4_K_M), qwen2.5-coder:1.5b, llama3.3, smollm2:360m.

- **POST /api/generate**
  Raw generation endpoint for low-level inference control.

### Public Hub Static API (:8088)

- **GET /api/tools.json**
  Static, publish-safe projection of the tool registry. Generated by scripts/generate-tools-json.py. Contains id, name, description, category, relative_path, runtimes, tags plus provenance metadata. Absolute paths and credentials are stripped.

## VAULT
================================================================================

### Argon2id BYOK Vault Daemon (:8787)

The vault daemon provides zero-knowledge memory enclaves on 127.0.0.1:8787.

#### Cryptographic Invariants

- **Key Derivation**: Argon2id (m=65536 KB, t=3, p=4)
- **Symmetric Cipher**: XChaCha20-Poly1305 with 192-bit nonces
- **Master Password**: Never persisted to disk; held only in page-locked RAM (mlock)
- **Zero-Leak Memory Policy**: Sensitive buffers wrapped in Rust Zeroize traits and zeroed upon drop

#### REST API Endpoints

- POST /v1/vault/derive — Derives a 256-bit symmetric session key from passphrase + salt
- POST /v1/vault/encrypt — Encrypts plaintext API key into ciphertext + nonce + auth tag
- POST /v1/vault/decrypt — Decrypts in-memory payload with ephemeral session token
- GET /v1/vault/status — Returns daemon lock status, active key slots, and memory footprint
- POST /api/vault/store — Store secret (key_alias, secret_value, passphrase)
- POST /api/vault/retrieve — Retrieve secret by alias

#### Usage Examples

```bash
# Store Secret
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/vault/store   -H "Content-Type: application/json"   -d '{"key_alias":"OPENAI_API_KEY","secret_value":"sk-xxx","passphrase":"master-secret"}'

# Retrieve Secret
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/vault/retrieve   -H "Content-Type: application/json"   -d '{"key_alias":"OPENAI_API_KEY","passphrase":"master-secret"}'
```

#### In-Browser Fallback

Uses PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations) + AES-GCM 256-bit for client-side storage when the Rust daemon is unavailable.

================================================================================
## MEMORY
================================================================================

### Cognitive Memory Daemon (:8788)

The Memory Whitespace Hub (/memory/ and /studio/netrunner-memory.html) is the dedicated sovereign cognitive space implementing a biomorphic associative vector database with Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) architecture.

#### Dual-Version Representation Architecture

Every memory recorded across Zoth Studio is automatically structured with two synchronized formats:

- **Human Narrative Digest (human_digest)**: Clean, distraction-free markdown storytelling crafted for human strategic review, milestone tracking, and calm thinking. Includes high-level context, intent, actions taken, outcome summaries, and key takeaways.
- **AI Full Spectrum Telemetry (ai_spectrum)**: Raw, lossless machine telemetry designed for deterministic AI agent reasoning, AST diff tracking, and tool replay. Contains exact CLI arguments, exit codes, output tails, byte sizes, AST invariants, and neuromodulator valence/arousal/dominance vectors. Formatted into <ai_spectrum> tags inside <memory_context> XML blocks for prompt injection.

#### CLS Architecture

- **Hippocampus (Fast Episodic Buffer)**: Rapidly encodes episodic experiences without catastrophic interference
- **Neocortex (Slow Semantic Manifold)**: Consolidates invariant schemas via Sharp-Wave Ripple (SWR) sleep replays
- **Dorsolateral Prefrontal Cortex (dlPFC)**: Maintains active working memory under a 7±2 chunk capacity buffer
- **Amygdala (Salience & Priority)**: Modulates memory retention and decay resistance via simulated dopamine and noradrenaline weighting

#### STDP Hebbian Plasticity

Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity governs multi-agent consensus alignment and memory consolidation:

Δw(Δt) = A+·e^(-Δt/τ+)  for Δt > 0 (LTP Strengthening)
Δw(Δt) = -A-·e^(Δt/τ-)  for Δt < 0 (LTD Pruning)

#### REST API Endpoints (:8788)

- GET /v1/memories — Query active memory ledger with topic, agent, and lobe filtering
- POST /v1/memories/encode — Ingest new episodic memory nodes with topic tags and key insights
- GET /v1/memories/recall?topic=... — Execute nearest-neighbor cosine associative recall
- POST /v1/memories/:id/perspectives — Attach multi-agent observer viewpoints and confidence scores
- GET /v1/beat/run — Trigger biological replay and synaptic pruning cycle
- POST /v1/autolink — Automatically establish STDP causal links between memories sharing 2+ topics
- GET /v1/brain/status — Returns total_nodes and total_synapses counts

#### Memory CLI Runbook

```bash
zoth mem list                          # View recent human narrative digests
zoth mem list --spectrum               # Inspect raw AI full-spectrum telemetry
zoth mem search "refactor theme tokens" # Search memories by semantic query
zoth mem search "webgen_compiler" --spectrum  # Search with spectrum telemetry
zoth mem prompt-context --mode dual --limit 5  # Generate XML memory context for agent prompts
zoth mem record-tool "webgen_compiler" "success" "Compiled 3-page Astro workspace" --output "OK"
zoth mem record-code "public/studio/swarm.html" "modified" "Added 3D laser sound effects"
```

#### Lucy Netrunner Oracle

Embodying Lucy from Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, this oracle navigates the 3D associative memory graph, performs Blackwall diagnostic scans, broadcasts deep neural context, and triggers audio voice lines. The Dual-View Workstation HUD switches between Human Digest and AI Full Spectrum modes in real time with 1-click XML prompt copying for LLM sessions.

## API ROUTES SUMMARY (Quick Reference)
================================================================================

### Operator Deck (:8484)
POST /api/zoth/swarm — Dispatch swarm prompt
POST /api/zoth/swarm/synthesize — Synthesize artifact
GET /api/zoth/swarm/status/:slug — Job status
GET /api/zoth/swarm/output/:slug/index.html — Generated output
POST /api/zoth/swarm/refine-plan — Feedback to @Azoth
POST /api/zoth/workspace/compile-files — Compile workspace
GET /api/tools — Live tool registry (298+ tools)
GET /api/dashboard — System dashboard telemetry
GET /api/health — Health check
POST /api/zoth/terminal/ducky/feedback — Terminal feedback
GET /api/pets — Companion pet roster

### Vault (:8787)
POST /v1/vault/derive — Derive session key
POST /v1/vault/encrypt — Encrypt secret
POST /v1/vault/decrypt — Decrypt payload
GET /v1/vault/status — Daemon status
POST /api/vault/store — Store secret
POST /api/vault/retrieve — Retrieve secret

### Memory (:8788)
GET /v1/memories — Query memory ledger
POST /v1/memories/encode — Ingest memory
GET /v1/memories/recall — Nearest-neighbor recall
POST /v1/memories/:id/perspectives — Attach viewpoints
GET /v1/beat/run — Trigger replay/pruning
POST /v1/autolink — STDP causal links
GET /v1/brain/status — Node/synapse counts

### SimpleX (:8767)
POST /api/simplex/send — Send E2EE message
GET /api/simplex/messages — Retrieve message queue

### Ollama (:11434)
POST /api/chat — Chat completion
POST /api/generate — Raw generation

### Public Hub (:8088)
GET /api/tools.json — Static tool registry projection
